title: LeWM Push-T dataset-defined reachable tasks, n expanded to 50 (Wilson CI tightening)
design: same shim dataset + World.evaluate(dataset=...) protocol as KW-LEWM-0003, only the number of tasks increased from 8 to 50; pixels re-rendered locally at 224x224; pure n-expansion with no other variable changed

predecessor.relation: n-expansion from 8 to 50 tasks to tighten Wilson CI; same protocol otherwise

config.task_source: public partial Parquet shard, same episode, 25 steps apart

statistical_caveat.issue: n=50 still cannot support a precise success-rate claim
statistical_caveat.supported_conclusion: reachable tasks yield valid control; true success rate in ~24%-50%; 0003's 8-task estimate was not small-sample noise (point estimate stable 0.375->0.36)
statistical_caveat.not_supported: any precise success-rate claim; official benchmark reproduction; comparison with JEPA-WM

methodological_finding_reinforced.claim: task reachability is a confounder whose magnitude exceeds model differences
methodological_finding_reinforced.evidence: same checkpoint/planner/scaler; success 0/8 (random) -> 18/50 (dataset, 0.36) purely from task source; point estimate stable across n=8 and n=50; success uncorrelated with task distance (rho=0.055)

data_integrity_note.issue: result JSON generated by reusing the KW-LEWM-0003 script with --pairs 50
data_integrity_note.experiment_id_field: still reads 'KW-LEWM-0003-DATASET-TASKS' (schema carryover, not a typo)
data_integrity_note.baseline_for_comparison_field: points only to KW-LEWM-0002 (random tasks); the 0003 (8 dataset) row is documented here in baseline_comparison
data_integrity_note.numeric_values_verified: n_success=18 and n_out_of_play=0 cross-checked against the file's own summary field

residual_approximations: scaler fitted on a partial shard (80,384 rows), not the official full training set
pixels re-rendered locally, not the dataset's recorded pixels
allowed_claim: Under a disclosed lite protocol, the official LeWM Push-T checkpoint produced valid closed-loop control on 50 dataset-defined reachable tasks: 18/50 succeeded (0.36, 95% CI [0.24, 0.50]) with zero out-of-play excursions, versus 0/8 and 25% out-of-play on randomly sampled tasks with everything else held fixed.
forbidden_claims: comparison with JEPA-WM or any competitor (no same-protocol control group)
